delivery.outcome: Validate adopter-owned stable error catalogs against the immutable Wellmanifest Logs contract without transferring runtime ownership or authority.
nonGoals: No product-specific error codes in wellmanifest/logs
No remediation execution or authority grant
No rewrite of published event streams

architecture.decision: Add a separate adopter-error-catalog manifest and read-only validation command. The manifest pins the canonical contract digest, owns one uppercase namespace, declares the exact code set and points to a confined Markdown directory. Strategies stay target-owned and policy defines invariants and forbidden outcomes rather than one recovery implementation.
interfaceChanges: New error-adoption conformance command and report
dataChanges: Append one immutable contract registration event for v0.3
architecture.rollback: Revert the new command and v0.3 category additions; existing v0.2 event bytes and repository validation remain unchanged.

validation.evidence: the merged governance base is in branch history and its verified receipt resolves inactive
